name: Moritz Zabel Frantz
original_name: モーリッツ・ザベル・フランツ
source:
High Priest in charge of the Church of Silent Moonlight in Mitsurugasaki. Has a gentle personality and makes no distinctions in his treat with anyone. Has taken care of Estel since her time in the orphanage, and she looks up to him as a father.

[edited from [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/夜明け前より瑠璃色な]Wikipedia[/url]]
